title: Raise validated Ruff floor
summary: Raise the validated Ruff development and SARIF workflow floor from 0.8 to 0.15.20 while retaining the pre-1.0 ceiling.
reason: Dependabot PR #36 validated the declared ruff>=0.15.20,<1 range across the complete GitHub matrix, where Generated context drift job 86718577394 resolved Ruff 0.15.21. The bundled repository runtime separately proved exact Ruff 0.15.20 through lint and SARIF generation. Aligning both installation surfaces prevents older unsupported lint behavior from satisfying the declared environment.
behavior_before: Development and SARIF environments could resolve any Ruff release from 0.8 through the current pre-1.0 series.
behavior_after: Development and SARIF environments require Ruff 0.15.20 or newer while retaining the existing <1 compatibility ceiling.
manual_validation: PASS: bundled runtime reported Ruff 0.15.20 and completed repository lint and SARIF generation.
PASS: Dependabot PR #36 run 29218368707, job 86718577394, installed Ruff 0.15.21 from the new range; its complete required matrix passed.
rollback_plan: Restore both Ruff floors to >=0.8,<1 and rerun lint, SARIF, and the complete GitHub matrix.
notes: The update changes tooling only; no lint rule, ignore, test, architecture guardrail, or release gate is weakened.
